name: TechBBQ 2022
description:
🔥 TechBBQ 2022 marks our 10th – or X – event, so this year, we are putting the X in eXtraordinary! 🔥


✨ Get ready for the most "hygge" tech & innovation summit in the Nordics. Every year, we gather thousands of attendees from the Nordic and Baltic region, as well as other parts of the world. We connect startup communities, entrepreneurs, tech talents, innovation enthusiasts, investors looking for new opportunities, and ecosystem builders.  


Join us in our amazing new venue Lokomotivværkstedet for two eXtraordinary days full of unforgettable moments with like-minded people! Get insights about the latest news in the ecosystem and see what's trending in the tech & innovation industry. ✨


✨ The event is an eXcellent opportunity to eXpand your horizons! 


This year, we have two ways for you to join: An In-person ticket will grant you full access (including online), while an Online access pass will connect you to live stream of our Main Stage and networking app. ✨


WHAT TO EXPECT: 


 💥 2 days fully-packed with an eXciting program, networking & showcasing


💥 6000+ attendees 


💥 Insightful keynote talks & panel discussions


💥 Garden sessions led by industry professionals


💥 Startup showcasing 


💥 Pitching competitions


💥 Access to afterparty 🥂


💥 Hygge vibes ✨

 
🎟️ Ticket sales are now open: https://bit.ly/3vkweMm

👉 Check out previous TechBBQ events: https://bit.ly/3OGVlAG

💡 Learn more on our website: https://bit.ly/3MsE4cy


🔥 TECHBBQ 2022:

📅 September 14-15

📍 Lokomotivværkstedet, Copenhagen


🔥 PROGRAM (both days):

✦ Check-in opens: 9:00 CEST
✦ Stage program starts: 10:00 CEST
✦ Stage program ends: 17:00 CEST
✦ Doors close: 18:00 CEST


𝗔𝗕𝗢𝗨𝗧 𝗧𝗘𝗖𝗛𝗕𝗕𝗤 

TechBBQ is a non-profit organization created by the community for the community with the goal of supporting and accelerating the Nordic and Baltic tech startup ecosystems. We are the pulse of innovation and technology in the Nordics. 💫
